blocks.title: Lesson Objectives
blocks.content:
- Explain economic problems in the Weimar Republic
- Describe political instability and weak government
- Explain how the Treaty of Versailles contributed to unrest

blocks.title: Hyperinflation
blocks.content: **Hyperinflation** is a rapid rise in prices.

blocks.title: Weak coalition governments
blocks.content: **Weak coalition governments** is unstable cabinet rule.

blocks.title: Treaty of Versailles impact
blocks.content: **Treaty of Versailles impact** is the burden placed on Germany after 1919.

blocks.title: Political extremism
blocks.content: **Political extremism** is the rise of extreme parties.

blocks.title: Reparations payments
blocks.content: **Reparations payments** is money paid by Germany under the treaty.

blocks.question: Explain the causes of World War Two.
Describe the structure of the Nazi police state.
